meta.title: The Ledger of Ways
meta.subtitle: Charted commercial & military crossings of the QTR frontier — every road anchored to a real light in the sky
meta.note: Names, operators and lore are imagined (QTR 'Immeasurable Spaces' canon); every waypoint is a real catalogued object.

routes.name: The Silk Road of Suns
routes.lore: The oldest lit road — beacon to beacon, the Assembly's ΛL phase kept so clean a courier can sleep the whole crossing.

routes.name: The Amber Ladder
routes.lore: Down the depth rungs with hulls full of cooled resin-metal; every dive buys a little more speed and a little more debt.

routes.name: The Widow's Ferry
routes.lore: The one-way pilgrimage into the fall — they go to see the Attractor and send letters that arrive centuries after the writer.

routes.name: The Pearl String
routes.lore: The busiest little run in the sky — clouds to clouds, threaded on the Magellanic bridge like beads on wet twine.

routes.name: The Long Tithe
routes.lore: The grain-and-glass road that feeds the deep seats of doctrine, all the way to the great weight of Shapley.

routes.name: The Glassmaker's Run
routes.lore: Whorl to whorl — the notation-keepers ferry squeezed-vacuum optics between the two great spirals and no one else is allowed to look.

routes.name: The Honeyed Reach
routes.lore: Out of the Beehive and into the great market of Virgo, where a single jet-lit galaxy sets the price of everything.

routes.name: The Salt Circuit
routes.lore: A scavengers' ring around the wreck of two clusters — they pull metal from the Bullet's wound and sell it cold in Coma.

routes.name: The Lantern Walk
routes.lore: Every waypoint a pulsar-lit shrine; pilgrims walk the beacon network by hand-log, refusing to trust the Assembly's clock.

routes.name: The Quiet Barter
routes.lore: Little galaxies trading little goods — a slow honest road that the great powers have never bothered to tax.

routes.name: The Cartographers' Loop
routes.lore: The Wolori chart the longest wall in the sky, one seam-approach at a time, adding a decimal to the map with every pass.

routes.name: The Seam-Silk
routes.lore: Crosser cloth, spun in the indeterminate gaps and sold before it settles — you buy it here and it is already elsewhere.

routes.name: The Emberline
routes.lore: Quasar to quasar with squeezed tanks — the richest and most damned road in the ledger; every hauler owes the Undertow.

routes.name: The Dowry Road
routes.lore: A whimsy that became an industry: betrothal-gifts carried past the Ring so the light of a dying star witnesses the vow.

routes.name: The Threadbare Way
routes.lore: For those who cannot pay to dive — a sub-light crawl between the ragged dwarfs, measured in lifetimes, walked anyway.

routes.name: The Kestrel Line
routes.lore: The fastest civilian post in the sky — a wing of couriers who race the Assembly's own beacons and usually win.

routes.name: The Spiral Tithe
routes.lore: Relics and reliquaries between the named spirals — the Assembly insists every crossing pause to log a verse.

routes.name: The Iron Meridian
routes.lore: The spine of the fleet — the road every campaign marches, from the home seats to the edge of the Great Web.

routes.name: The Widowmaker Picket
routes.lore: The watch along the emptiness — pickets ride the wall's edge and stare into the Nothing, and some ride in and don't come back.

routes.name: The Ashen Blockade
routes.lore: A ring of guns holding a supercluster shut; the ash of the last relief attempt still drifts on the approach.

routes.name: The Nūbi Deep-Strike
routes.lore: The divers' war-lane — they fall to the Attractor, strike Shapley from below, and rise before the light of it reaches home.

routes.name: The Serpent's Watch
routes.lore: The long coil around the Centaurus marches — a patrol so old the crews have forgotten what they were told to fear.

routes.name: The Broken Lance
routes.lore: A campaign that shattered on the Bullet's shock-front and never reached Shapley; the road is charted for the dead who still march it.

routes.name: The Last Bastion Run
routes.lore: Globular to globular — the old fortress-clusters, packed tight enough to hide a fleet, resupplied under the guns.

routes.name: The Reaver's Cut
routes.lore: A fast hunting sweep through the crowded young clusters where reaver-crews hide their squeezed tanks between the stars.

routes.name: The Crown Patrol
routes.lore: The defense ring of the home reach — the fleet that never leaves, circling the three great neighbours of Sol forever.

routes.name: The Silent March
routes.lore: A dark lane run with beacons off and ΛL held by hand — the divers' quiet way to the Sculptor deeps.

routes.name: The Hangman's Route
routes.lore: One waypoint out, none back — the Assembly's sentence of exile is a heading into the Boötes Nothing and a locked drive.

routes.name: The Cold Vigil
routes.lore: The loneliest watch — a picket set against the Fornax deeps, relieved so rarely the crews name their own graves.

routes.name: The Drowned Fleet's Road
routes.lore: A funeral circuit through three battle-scars, walked once a generation with the drives set to the tempo of a dirge.

routes.name: The Kestrel Screen
routes.lore: A screen of fast pickets thrown out past the Clouds — the first to see a thing come up out of the local deep.

routes.name: The Marrow Line
routes.lore: The bloodiest supply run in the ledger — everything the Hercules front eats comes up the Marrow, and it is never enough.

routes.name: The Spice Road of Carina
routes.lore: Aromatics off the great nursery, worth more by weight than any metal — the Concord's fortune in a sealed hold.

routes.name: The Vintner's Reach
routes.lore: Casks aged the whole crossing, so a bottle tastes of the years it took to arrive.

routes.name: The Pearl of Tucanae
routes.lore: The brightest globular in the south sets the price of light itself; the Concord buys it cheap and sells it dear.

routes.name: The Reliquary of M87
routes.lore: Bones of saints carried to the jet-lit throne of Virgo, where every relic is weighed against its own legend.

routes.name: The Glass Run of the Sombrero
routes.lore: Cut optics for the deep telescopes, ferried under the brim of the hat-galaxy where the light is always low.

routes.name: The Amber Run of the Pinwheel
routes.lore: Resin-metal from the great whorl, cooled in transit until it rings like a struck bell.

routes.name: The Candlemaker's Way
routes.lore: Wax and wick for a thousand shrines, so no waypoint in the ledger ever goes dark.

routes.name: The Grain Road of Fornax
routes.lore: The bread road of the southern dwarfs — plain cargo, honest crews, and no war has ever bothered to close it.

routes.name: The Silk of the Antennae
routes.lore: Spun in the tidal wreck of two colliding galaxies, where the thread is drawn out longer than anywhere else.

routes.name: The Ice Haul of the Helix
routes.lore: Cometary ice from the eye of the Helix — the coldest, cleanest water in the ledger, sold to the thirsty deep.

routes.name: The Incense Way of the Rosette
routes.lore: Sacred smoke gathered in the rose and carried to the shrines, so the faithful may breathe a little of the making.

routes.name: The Dye Road of the Cat's Eye
routes.lore: Pigments drawn from a dying star's iris — a purple no loom can fake and no Assembly can tax.

routes.name: The Vellum Run
routes.lore: Blank charts out, filled charts back — the notation-keepers trade in the one commodity that grows by being spent.

routes.name: The Long Ferry of Andromeda
routes.lore: The great passenger road home — a ferry so old the crews are born, wed and buried between its two ends.

routes.name: The Jewel Courier
routes.lore: Small parcels, high value, faster than gossip — the Wing's proudest run through the youngest, brightest stones.

routes.name: The Salt of Eridanus
routes.lore: A lonely loop skirting the great Cold Spot void — they say the salt keeps better where the sky is emptiest.

routes.name: The Lantern Road of Omega
routes.lore: Pulsar to pulsar into the heart of the greatest globular, each shrine brighter than the last.

routes.name: The Honey Road of Bode
routes.lore: Sweet cargo up the northern pair, where Bode and the Cigar have traded since before the ledger was kept.

routes.name: The Furnace Run of 3C 273
routes.lore: Straight into the brightest engine in the sky — the Cartel fuels the fleet and owes the Undertow a fortune in years.

routes.name: The Emberline of the Blazars
routes.lore: A jet-lit haul between the beam-throwers, run by crews who never once look their cargo in the eye.

routes.name: The Deep Relic Road
routes.lore: To the oldest lit thing anyone has charted — a pilgrimage so deep only the Composite can make it, and few return in time to tell.

routes.name: The Coral Ferry
routes.lore: The little short-haul that never sleeps — cloud to cloud across the Magellanic bridge, holds full both ways.

routes.name: The Sagittarius Pilgrimage
routes.lore: The near pilgrimage, walked slow and on purpose — the faithful hold that speed cheapens the going.

routes.name: The Silk of Leo
routes.lore: A quiet thread between the twin lions, where two little galaxies have grown rich on patience.

routes.name: The Wine Road of Perseus
routes.lore: Up through the double stones to the great Perseus market, casks singing in the hold the whole way.

routes.name: The Grey Ferry
routes.lore: A workaday lane along the second great wall, freight so dull no pirate has ever bothered it.

routes.name: The Bullet Ore-Road
routes.lore: Metal pulled from the wound where two clusters struck and passed through each other — the richest scrap in the ledger.

routes.name: The Owl Reliquary Run
routes.lore: Charted by an order that flies only in the dark of the beacons; even the Assembly cannot say where it truly ends.

routes.name: The Eagle Spice Road
routes.lore: Off the pillars where stars are still being made — the freshest cargo in the sky, and the Concord's flagship run.

routes.name: The Chandler's Loop
routes.lore: An old-stars' exchange between two sober open clusters — nothing flashy, just the ledger's steady heartbeat.

routes.name: The Centaurus Amber Ladder
routes.lore: Down the rungs to the great southern engine, each dive buying speed and selling the crew a little more time.

routes.name: The Triangulum Ferry
routes.lore: The third great neighbour's passenger road — quieter than Andromeda's, and the crews prefer it that way.

routes.name: The Hyades Pearl Run
routes.lore: The nearest little run in the whole book — you could almost see the far end from the near, if the dust would let you.

routes.name: The Cartwheel Survey
routes.lore: The Wolori chart a ring-galaxy's ripple, adding a decimal each pass and arguing about it for a generation.

routes.name: The Sculptor Salt Circuit
routes.lore: A rim-run around a nearby emptiness, where the crews swear the salt cures sweeter for the silence.

routes.name: The Wanderer's Road
routes.lore: Out to the loneliest members of the family — WLM and the ragged NGC 3109, who see a hull maybe twice a lifetime.

routes.name: The Gilded Run of Laniakea
routes.lore: The trunk of trunks — everything of value, sooner or later, rides some length of the road to the Great Web.

routes.name: The Shapley Spice Trunk
routes.lore: The deepest sweet-cargo road in the ledger, run to the great weight itself where a spice keeps its worth for eons.

routes.name: The Ferry of the Lost
routes.lore: A pilgrimage for the bereaved — a slow loop past three graves in the sky, and a fare paid in candles.

routes.name: The Taurus Amber Run
routes.lore: A short haul that clips the near Taurus emptiness — the Syndics like a road no one else will share.

routes.name: The Glassmaker's Descent
routes.lore: Down to a fortress-globular where the sand runs clean and the furnaces never want for the dark.

routes.name: The Hercules Pilgrimage
routes.lore: The great northern pilgrimage into the Hercules globular, where a message was once beamed to no one who ever answered.

routes.name: The Coster's Run
routes.lore: A cheerful hawkers' road between three tight old globulars, holds rattling with a hundred small trades.

routes.name: The Horsehead Reliquary
routes.lore: Shadows sold as relics off the dark horse of Orion — the buyers know it is only dust, and pay anyway.

routes.name: The Orion Spice Road
routes.lore: Off the great sword-nursery — every hull in the near reach has run a length of it at least once.

routes.name: The Perseus-Pisces Silk Trunk
routes.lore: Along the great chain of clusters — the longest bolt of cloth the Assembly has ever charted, and the proudest.

routes.name: The Sculptor Grain Run
routes.lore: The plain, patient bread road of the southern group — the League's oldest and least glamorous fortune.

routes.name: The Giant Void Amber Reach
routes.lore: The longest, loneliest reach the Syndics keep — a rim-road along the great Canes emptiness, run once a decade for pride.

routes.name: The Butterfly Vintage
routes.lore: A summer road among the near open clusters, casks warmed just so by the young blue stars.

routes.name: The Local Void Courier
routes.lore: A fast skirt of the near emptiness at the family's edge — the Wing's shortest road to nowhere and back.

routes.name: The Microscopium Pearl Run
routes.lore: A southern rim-run past a supervoid, where the Concord swears the dark makes a brighter stone.

routes.name: The Capricornus Silk Road
routes.lore: Cloth spun on the long approach to a southern void, thread drawn finer the emptier the sky.

routes.name: The Lagoon Chandlery
routes.lore: Ship's-stores off the great southern nursery — wick, wax, water and rope for the whole near fleet.

routes.name: The Coma Vintage Road
routes.lore: A gentle road through the nearest loose cluster to the great Coma market — casks in, coin out.

routes.name: The Antennae Reliquary
routes.lore: Fragments of two galaxies tearing each other apart, sold as relics of the end of things.

routes.name: The Gemini Spice Lane
routes.lore: A near, busy lane between the twin nurseries — the Concord's apprentices cut their teeth on it.

routes.name: The Cetus Grey Road
routes.lore: A dull, dependable lane out to a barred spiral with a bright and secret heart — the Factors ask no questions.

routes.name: The Cigar Ferry
routes.lore: A short, smoky ferry across to the starburst galaxy, where the crews say the air itself is worth the fare.

routes.name: The Jewel Amber Run
routes.lore: Resin cut to catch the light of the youngest coloured stars — the Syndics' prettiest, if not their richest, road.

routes.name: The Pillar Pilgrimage
routes.lore: To the pillars where the faithful go to watch stars being born, and to be a little remade themselves.

routes.name: The Scorpius Salt Run
routes.lore: A near-globular loop, the Factors' training run — three tight old cities of stars and a hold full of white.

routes.name: The Double Courier
routes.lore: Through the twin open clusters at a full run — the Wing's showpiece, flown fast enough to make the passengers pray.

routes.name: The Sloan Vellum Road
routes.lore: The longest survey the Wolori keep — the whole Great Wall charted seam by seam, a life's work per crew.

routes.name: The Beehive Honey Road
routes.lore: The sweetest little near-road in the book, from the hive to the seven sisters and home before the crews are missed.

routes.name: The Ring Reliquary Way
routes.lore: Relics blessed in the smoke ring of a dead sun, then carried home to be believed in.

routes.name: The Carina Deep Spice Run
routes.lore: Down the southern nursery to the great globular below — the Concord's long road, and its most fragrant.

routes.name: The Magellanic Grain Road
routes.lore: Bread for the cloud-cities — the Factors' oldest and plainest fortune, run so often the beacons know the crews by name.

routes.name: The Whirlpool Amber Ladder
routes.lore: Cooled resin-metal spun out of a grand-design spiral, the finest grain the Syndics ever sell.

routes.name: The Fornax Silk Road
routes.lore: Cloth for the southern cluster-market, a modest bolt but a dependable one.

routes.name: The Barnard Ferry
routes.lore: A slow near-ferry to a ragged little galaxy — the crews go for the quiet as much as the coin.

routes.name: The Virgo Vintage Trunk
routes.lore: The great cellar-road to the market of a thousand galaxies, where a good vintage can set the price of a whole cluster.

routes.name: The Attractor Reliquary
routes.lore: A pilgrimage into the fall itself — the faithful go to feel the great weight and are never quite the same after.

routes.name: The Capricorn Salt Circuit
routes.lore: A dry southern loop that grazes a void, salt cured in the emptiest air the Factors can find.

routes.name: The Elder Courier
routes.lore: Between the oldest open clusters, a road for slow news and old friends.

routes.name: The Southern Spice Lane
routes.lore: A bright, busy southern lane past the young clusters to the great Tucanae globular.

routes.name: The Cartwheel Amber Reach
routes.lore: Resin cut from a ring-galaxy's shockwave — a strange, striped grain the Syndics can charge a strange price for.

routes.name: The Cat's Eye Pilgrimage
routes.lore: A lantern-lit walk to a dying star's bright iris — the Wardens say it is the most watchful thing in the sky.

routes.name: The Antennae Glass Run
routes.lore: Lensing optics ground in the wreck of two galaxies, where the light bends in ways no other glass can copy.

routes.name: The Triangulum Grain Ferry
routes.lore: Bread for the third neighbour — the plainest, most necessary road in the near sky.

routes.name: The Omega Silk Descent
routes.lore: Cloth carried down into the greatest globular, sold by the yard to a city of a million ancient suns.

routes.name: The Nursery Courier
routes.lore: The Wing's grand tour of the great star-forges, flown fast enough to see three born in a single watch.

routes.name: The Drowned Cloud Reliquary
routes.lore: Relics of ships lost in the Magellanic deep, carried back to be mourned in the light of the clouds that took them.

routes.name: The Sombrero Amber Trunk
routes.lore: The great southern grain-road under the brim, holds so full the hulls ride low the whole way to Virgo.

routes.name: The Jewel Vintage
routes.lore: A little southern cellar-road among the coloured stones, casks tinted, the League swears, by the light itself.

routes.name: The Seven Sisters' Pilgrimage
routes.lore: The nearest holy road of all — to the seven blue sisters, where every young crew makes its first vow.

routes.name: The Perseus Spice Trunk
routes.lore: The northern spice road to the great cluster, aromatics that keep their fire the whole long climb.

routes.name: The Wall Grey Trunk
routes.lore: The dull, endless freight of the great walls — the Factors move more tonnage than anyone and are spoken of by none.

routes.name: The Sculptor Ferry
routes.lore: A passenger road down the southern group, three galaxies in a line and a fare that hasn't changed in an age.

routes.name: The Carina Amber Road
routes.lore: Resin off the great southern nursery, cut and cooled and carried down to Tucanae to be strung and sold.

routes.name: The Coma Silk Trunk
routes.lore: The great northern cloth-road to the Coma market, where the price of silk is the price of everything.

routes.name: The Antennae Courier
routes.lore: A fast run to the colliding pair for those who need to be seen to have been there — the Wing asks no reason.

routes.name: The Lagoon Reliquary
routes.lore: Waters of the great nursery bottled and blessed — the buyers drink the making of stars and call it grace.

routes.name: The Leo Grain Run
routes.lore: Bread for the twin lions, a small league's small fortune, honest to the last crumb.

routes.name: The Tucanae Spice Descent
routes.lore: Down into the bright southern globular, aromatics sold by the pinch to a city that has smelled nothing new in an age.

routes.name: The Great Chain Amber Trunk
routes.lore: The deepest grain-road the Syndics keep, all the way along the great chain — a crossing measured in fortunes and years.

routes.name: The Hercules Vintage
routes.lore: Casks up the northern climb to the great supercluster, aged in the long dark to a taste the League will not describe.

routes.name: The Orion Pilgrimage
routes.lore: The oldest near-pilgrimage of all, to the sword of Orion where the faithful say the first hulls were blessed.

routes.name: The Pegasus Salt Run
routes.lore: A tight northern globular loop, the Factors' quiet fortune, white cargo and whiter crews.

routes.name: The Centaurus Grey Road
routes.lore: A dull dependable southern lane to the great radio galaxy — the Factors move the freight no one wants to name.

routes.name: The Cloud-Deep Courier
routes.lore: The busiest post in the near sky — parcels and passengers across the whole Magellanic reach, flown flat out.

routes.name: The Eridanus Amber Vigil
routes.lore: The Syndics' loneliest road, run along the great Cold Spot void once a generation to keep an old claim alive.

routes.name: The Shapley Silk Trunk
routes.lore: The deepest cloth-road in the ledger, all the way to the great weight — a bolt that outlasts the loom that spun it.

routes.name: The Cartwheel Reliquary Reach
routes.lore: Shards of a struck galaxy sold as relics of collision — proof, the sellers say, that even the sky can be wounded.

routes.name: The Wild Duck Grain Road
routes.lore: Bread for the great flock of a cluster, a plain southern road the Haulers have kept since anyone can remember.

routes.name: The Rosette Spice Way
routes.lore: Aromatics from the rose, carried while they are still warm from the making — the Concord's freshest cargo.

routes.name: The Double Amber Run
routes.lore: Resin cut to catch the twin light of the double cluster — a northern stone that fetches a northern price.

routes.name: The Fornax Deep Ferry
routes.lore: A long southern passenger road to the deep cluster, a fare paid once and remembered for a lifetime.

routes.name: The Sombrero Silk Descent
routes.lore: Cloth carried under the great brim to the Virgo market — the Assembly's smoothest, most secret road.

routes.name: The Bode Courier
routes.lore: A short fast post between the northern pair and their little companions — the Wing's quietest, cosiest run.

routes.name: The Helix Reliquary Way
routes.lore: Relics blessed in the great eye of the Helix, where the Wardens hold a dead sun still watches the living.

routes.name: The Bridge Grain Ferry
routes.lore: Bread across the very Magellanic Bridge itself — the shortest, busiest, most necessary road the Factors keep.

routes.name: The Grey Marshals' Vigil
routes.lore: The long grey watch along the second wall, kept by an order that has forgotten every war it was raised to fight.

routes.name: The Ashen Siege of Virgo
routes.lore: A ring of guns around the great market, raised in a war no one remembers starting and no one dares end.

routes.name: The Serpent's Coil
routes.lore: A patrol wound thrice around the southern marches, so tight the crews can hand a message hull to hull.

routes.name: The Verge Watch of Boötes
routes.lore: The loneliest picket in the ledger — a watch set against the Great Nothing, relieved so seldom the crews go strange.

routes.name: The Ninth Fleet's Road
routes.lore: The road the Ninth marches to war — up through the great clusters to the edge of the Web, and rarely back the same.

routes.name: The Bastion Relief Run
routes.lore: Globular to globular under the guns, the Order feeding its stone fortresses one dangerous crossing at a time.

routes.name: The Sable Screen
routes.lore: A black screen of fast hulls thrown out past the near dwarfs — the first to die if a thing comes up from the deep.

routes.name: The Long Watch of the Fall
routes.lore: A picket set at the lip of the Great Attractor, watching the one direction from which nothing has ever returned.

routes.name: The Iron Blockade of Perseus
routes.lore: A wall of guns holding the great northern chain shut — the Synod's oldest siege, and its most patient.

routes.name: The Kestrel War-Road
routes.lore: The Wing's other face — a strike-lane flown so fast the enemy sees the wreckage before the ship.

routes.name: The Legion's Dirge
routes.lore: A funeral march past the drowned battle-grounds of the south, drives set to the slow tempo of the dead.

routes.name: The Verge Exile Road
routes.lore: One heading out and a locked drive — the Assembly's second sentence of exile, into the Eridanus Nothing.

routes.name: The Ashen Cloud Picket
routes.lore: The near guard of the family's edge — a picket set against the Local Void, watching the door of the home reach.

routes.name: The Serpent Siege
routes.lore: The deepest siege in the ledger, a coil of guns around the great weight itself, kept by crews who never see home.
